values.note: Electric sites $30 a night (rate effective January 1, 2026); the non-electric group site is $100. The first two tents on a site are included; each further tent is $15 a night.

fees.source: https://www.co.dodge.wi.gov/lrp-parks/fees ('Electric Sites - $30'; 'Group Site $100'; 'Reservation Fee $6 (non-refundable)'; 'Each subsequent tent $15 per night'); Premier booking page ('Effective January 1, 2026 ... Electric site rate - $30 per night - Reservation fee - $6')

hookups.source: https://www.co.dodge.wi.gov/lrp-parks/harnischfeger-park ('8 - 50-amp Electric Camp Sites (Water Hookup Available)'); park map ('NUMBERED - ELECTRIC (20/30/50 amp)'; 'SITES 1-8 - WATER HOOKUPS')

values.note: Eight electric sites with water (1-8) and one non-electric group site with no wheeled units.

sites.source: https://www.co.dodge.wi.gov/lrp-parks/harnischfeger-park ('8 - 50-amp Electric Camp Sites (Water Hookup Available)'; '1 - Group Site (Non-Electric/No Wheeled Units on Site)')

facilities.source: https://www.co.dodge.wi.gov/lrp-parks/harnischfeger-park ('Potable Water Fill and Dump Station'; 'Shower Building (Free)'; 'Flushable Toilets')

season.source: Premier booking page ('Camping Season - April 15th through October 31st. Day use throughout the year.'); https://www.co.dodge.wi.gov/lrp-parks/faqs ('Camping Season in Dodge County Parks is April 15 to October 31. There is no winter camping allowed in the parks.')

values.note: Online or by phone to the Parks Central Office (920-386-3700 x1, weekdays 8-4:30). At most 7 nights on one site and 14 nights per group at the park, then 48 hours away.

booking.source: https://www.co.dodge.wi.gov/lrp-parks/faqs ('Online reservations have a $6 non-refundable fee and can be made online up to a year in advance.'; 'Campers may stay a maximum seven (7) nights per site and a total of 14 nights per reservation group at each individual park. Campers must vacate the park for 48 hours after a 14 night stay.'); park page ('Reservations - 920-386-3700 x1 Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.')

note: Dodge County park on the Rock River, about 8 mi east of Watertown. The eight sites sit on short spurs along the road to the canoe launch, between a backwater wetland and a wooded strip on the river. --Claude
summary: County: $30 electric + $6 reservation fee (2026), 8 sites 50A + water, 1 group site, showers, dump, Apr 15-Oct 31, Premier Campground booking, 7-night per-site max. Riverview kept (sites 4-8 about 40-50 m from the Rock River behind a wooded bank strip). Pin kept.
